visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short grey hair and glasses, wearing a dark green button-up shirt, stands in a studio setting. Behind him is a large image of a cat yawning widely on a leather sofa. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting his expressive face and hand gestures. (2) The scene cuts to a digital visualization of a cosmic nebula in space. A bright, pulsating white star, representing a pulsar, is centered amidst swirls of vibrant purple, magenta, and dark blue clouds. Small twinkling stars dot the background. Yellow variety text appears at the bottom. (3) Returning to the presenter, he continues to speak directly to the camera. He holds a small black remote control in his right hand, using it to emphasize his points. The background cat image remains static. He uses broad hand gestures to explain scientific concepts. (4) A graphic transition shows an infographic on a dark blue background. It displays two sets of waveforms: one for low-frequency whale songs and another for high-frequency dolphin calls. A central bar marks the human hearing range. Small animal icons accompany the waveforms. (5) Back to the presenter, who maintains a professional and engaging demeanor. He looks directly at the lens, his facial expressions shifting to match the tone of his explanation. Traditional Chinese subtitles are centered at the bottom of the frame against his dark shirt. (6) A technical graph appears, featuring multiple overlapping sine waves in red dashed lines, blue dashed lines, and a solid black envelope. The graph is simple and clear, with white and black axes labeled with mathematical symbols to illustrate wave interference patterns. (7) The presenter reappears, using his fingers to count off points as he explains a mathematical formula. His movements are synchronized with his speech. The indoor lighting remains consistent, casting soft shadows and providing high clarity of the character and the foreground objects. (8) A circular blue animation pulses at the center of a black screen. It features concentric glowing rings and a dense core, serving as a visual metaphor for a rhythmic beat or a pulsar's signal. The animation is smooth and high-contrast. (9) The man concludes his talk with a slight smile, maintaining a friendly and accessible posture. The static image of the yawning cat and the top banner remain visible until the video ends. The overall visual style is clean, educational, and slightly playful.
